第246章 天魔门下人才济济地府的交代（第1页）
悄然离开佛国后，邓苍澜又在无人察觉的情况下，离开了罗浮洞天。
此行目的皆已达到，多留无益，说不得还会被那位郭少侠刁难。
邓苍澜回想起天庭遗址的初见，不由心生感慨和唏嘘，那会的郭少侠多顺眼啊，果然是江湖催人变。
邓苍澜走入了一座不大不小的集镇，路边支着一个馄饨
青年一袭素青色长袍，面如冠玉，浅笑之间，当真是谦谦君子，温其如玉。
身后两人也是得理不饶人。对着面前不知什么身份的林寒，淡淡的说道，虽然不敢呵斥林寒，那是因为不知道林寒是什么身份，但是说话也不算客气。
“妈，明成一时没想明白，先让他冷静一下，等过些日子，气消了，自然也就回来了。您别和他置气，自己的身子才最重要。”叶宁在一边劝道。
荀千灵白我一眼，淡定地走进浴室，没关门，意思是不介意我进去。
尽管努力让自己显得轻松，保持微笑，可当车子离医院越来越近，我紧张的情绪还是不自禁的流露到了脸上。
大姐在显屏上能看到是我，所以裹着毛巾被、光着脚丫子就出来给我开门了，一副没睡醒的样子，啥形象也没有。
朱满福望着马芸珊在徐世涛怀里撒娇挑情，闷声闷气的给自己灌了几杯酒，这才心情稍微舒畅些，盘算着等到待会儿，徐世涛带着曲曼婷离开，自己也带着马芸珊到酒店去。
沈语西心里一惊，扭头看着谢雨萌，只是她语气正常，脸色平静。沈语西猜不懂谢雨萌的心思，一时愣住了。
方才露出一丝笑容的荀千灵，一秒钟就变成了凶灵，深深地憋着一口气，让她原本不太显眼的胸口撑起老高，看起来标致了许多。
方济东有些懵，他本来还想着，沈语西大概不相信他说的只是普通朋友，他应该怎样去解释宋青，他很讨厌那段往事，所以并不太想和她讲。结果沈语西竟然接了这么一段，方济东竟不知该说什么了。
“哎，真没想到遇到如此阔绰的公子，赚了！”掂量着那沉甸甸的银子，卖包子的中年人喜得乐呵乐呵得，那嘴角都合不上了。
他目光死死地盯着王晨的脸，盯了好几秒钟，然后哼了一声，转身离开会议室。
“主人，附近的星域、星球，短时间内，不可能聚集一支具有对抗这些神族强者的队伍。”维塞摇头道。

殷枫再次往下走去，然而这一次他刚一踏下石阶便仿佛踏入了另一个世界，山川在他脚下，云雾浮在腰间，头顶是一片雷海，而眼前是各种水露悬浮。
林谷雨响起如意房间里面那些东西都带着一个“苏”字，浑身上下的汗毛颤栗起来。
“没有没有，可汗就是派人来问问，将士们可觉着我们鲜卑的牛羊吃着香嫩。”拓跋力微随口编了个谎，顺便不动声的把自己额头的冷汗抹掉。
云飞宛若闲庭信步、风轻云淡的态度，让一众魔族强者好奇之余，更觉其太过骄狂，不约而同外放神魂之力，向云飞威压而来。
好在她早有预谋，找人跟踪了戒玄曜，不然的话，这场戏就白瞎了。
这忽如其来的一句告白，令靳烽大脑瞬间一片空白，他张了张嘴，没说出话但眼睛却渐渐湿透了。
汲取运用恒星能量，在下界的皇天皇朝就已经可以，那类似“戴森球”的阵法，可以将一颗恒星包裹起来，抽取其中能量。

Chapter 246: An explanation of the many talented people under the Demon Sect (Page 1)
After quietly leaving the Buddhist Kingdom, Deng Canglan left the Luofu Cave without anyone noticing.
The purpose of this trip has been achieved. It is useless to stay any longer. There is no chance that the young hero Guo will make things difficult for him.
Deng Canglan recalled the first time he saw the Tianting ruins, and couldn't help but sigh with emotion. Guo Shaoxia was so pleasing to the eye at that time. It was true that the world was a catalyst for change.
Deng Canglan walked into a small market town, with a wonton propped up on the roadside.
The young man was dressed in a plain blue robe, with a face like a crown of jade, and a slight smile. He really looked like a humble gentleman, as gentle as jade.
The two people behind him were also unforgiving. Facing the unknown Lin Han in front of him, he said calmly, although he didn't dare to scold Lin Han because he didn't know his identity, but he didn't say it politely.
"Mom, Mingcheng didn't understand for a while. Let him calm down first. After a while, the anger will subside and he will naturally come back. Don't get angry with him. Your own body is the most important." Ye Ning advised at the side.
Xun Qianling gave me a blank look and walked into the bathroom calmly without closing the door, indicating that he didn't mind me going in.
Although I tried hard to look relaxed and smile, as the car got closer and closer to the hospital, my nervousness could not help but show on my face.
The eldest sister could see it was me on the screen, so she came out and opened the door for me, wrapped in a towel and quilt, with bare feet, as if she hadn't woken up and had no image at all.
Zhu Manfu watched Ma Yunshan acting coquettishly and flirtatiously in Xu Shitao's arms. He poured himself a few glasses of wine in a sullen voice, and then he felt a little better. He planned to wait until Xu Shitao left with Qu Manting, and he would take Ma Yunshan to the hotel.
Shen Yuxi was shocked and turned to look at Xie Yumeng, but her tone was normal and her face was calm. Shen Yuxi couldn't understand Xie Yumeng's thoughts and was stunned for a moment.
Xun Qianling, who had just shown a smile, turned into a fierce spirit in a second. She took a deep breath and made her originally inconspicuous chest lift up Lao Gao, making her look much more beautiful.
Fang Jidong was a little confused. He was originally thinking that Shen Yuxi probably didn't believe that he was just talking about ordinary friends. How should he explain Song Qing? He hated that past event, so he didn't really want to tell her about it. As a result, Shen Yuxi actually answered such a paragraph, and Fang Jidong didn't know what to say.
"Hey, I didn't expect to meet such a wealthy young man and make a profit!" Weighing the heavy amount of money, the middle-aged bun seller was so happy that he couldn't even close his mouth.
He stared at Wang Chen's face for several seconds, then snorted, turned around and left the conference room.
"Master, in the nearby star fields and planets, it is impossible to gather a team capable of resisting these powerful gods in a short period of time." Visser shook his head.
Yin Feng walked down again, but this time he seemed to have stepped into another world as soon as he stepped off the stone steps. Mountains and rivers were at his feet, clouds and mist were floating around his waist, there was a sea of ​​thunder above his head, and all kinds of water and dew were floating in front of him.
Lin Guyu heard that the things in Ruyi's room all had the word "Su" in them, and the hairs all over his body trembled.
"No, no, the Khan just sent someone to ask if the soldiers think our Xianbei cattle and sheep are delicious and tender." Tuoba Liwei made up a lie casually, and quietly wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
Yun Fei's casual and calm attitude made a group of strong demons curious and felt that he was too arrogant. They unanimously released the power of their souls and came to pressure Yun Fei.
Fortunately, she had already planned and found someone to follow Jie Xuanyao, otherwise, this scene is in vain.
This sudden confession made Jin Feng's mind go blank for a moment. He opened his mouth and said nothing, but his eyes gradually became wet.
Absorbing and using star energy is already possible in the Huangtian Dynasty in the lower realm. A formation similar to the "Dyson Sphere" can wrap a star and extract its energy.
